properties.title: IMR benthic biomass baseline — fallback (D_{pre,i})
properties.description: Institute of Marine Research regional baseline used when MAREANO has no taxon coverage at index i. Provides the fallback D_{pre,i} binding for the reef-biomass equation.

experimentInput.name: IMR benthic biomass baseline
experimentInput.description: Institute of Marine Research regional baseline benthic biomass density. Reusable across any experiment that needs a baseline density fallback on this footprint.

provenance.note: All densities, uncertainties, the sample period and ICES division IVa annotation above are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders, not IMR measurements. AphiaIDs are real (WoRMS). IMR's public data catalogue does not expose a single REST endpoint returning per-taxon benthic biomass density (kg/m²) for an AOI; cruise sample data is published as downloadable packages via NMD.

nearestAuthoritativeSource.note: Catalogue page for IMR research data; the actual benthic sample series are distributed via the Norwegian Marine Data Centre (NMD) as discrete datasets, not via a per-AOI REST call. For per-record observations, use OBIS: https://api.obis.org/v3/occurrence?scientificname=Mytilus%20edulis&geometry=<wkt>&size=500. The `https://www.hi.no/api/benthic-biomass-baseline` URL in this record's `source` field is a NOTIONAL endpoint used by the demonstrator's CWL workflow — it is NOT a verified IMR public API.

provenance.verificationGap: Verified that no public IMR REST API matches the `source` URL pattern as of the date in this record. Real retrieval requires NMD dataset download + offline aggregation.
